text:
marta: heads up — our replay harness shows ~12-18% higher p95 token latency vs synthetic on the new Ampere pools. suspect env parity (drivers/containers) or kernel selection differences. anyone seen this pattern?
sam: noted. can you paste the exact bench command + env?
marta: ran `tools/run_bench.py --mode replay --model gpt-4-small --seq 1024 --concurrency 32 --batching auto` on gpu pool `ampere-prod-2` and `a100-prod-1`. replay dataset is last week's traffic capture (synthetic used uniform seq distribution).
leo: quick question — are both pools using the same CUDA and driver versions? small driver differences have bitten us before.
marta: ampere: CUDA 11.8 / driver 525.85, a100: CUDA 11.8 / driver 525.85 as reported by `nvidia-smi`. container image for ampere is `redwood/runtime:2025-02-19` while a100 is `redwood/runtime:2025-02-10` (we updated some kernel flags in the later image).
tae: that image diff could include different ROCm/kernels? we only changed `--env RUNTIME_KERNEL_FLAGS=fast_mm`. can we try identical image?
marta: repro snippet I used: ```bash
# on ampere
docker run --gpus all -e RUNTIME_KERNEL_FLAGS=fast_mm \
  redwood/runtime:2025-02-19 /bin/bash -c "python tools/run_bench.py --mode replay --dataset lastweek.json --concurrency 32"
```
leo: thanks. can you also paste a small profile (nvprof / nsys) or the runtime's op-time breakdown? even top-line counters help.
marta: pasted simplified profiler output (sensitive trimmed): ```
KV_CACHE_HIT_RATE: 0.72
AVG_KERNEL_MS: 0.84
ATTN_KERNEL_MS: 0.44
MATMUL_MS: 0.26
CUDA_MEMCPY_MS: 0.08
```
zara: KV hit rate 0.72 seems OK but replay has more prefix sharing — weird to be worse on Ampere. Could kernel selection heuristics be choosing a different matmul kernel for small batches/seq?
sam: we recently adjusted kernel selector thresholds in 2025-02-15 to favor cuBLASLt for >256 head dims. That landed in `runtime:2025-02-19`. maybe a100's older image fell back to our custom tiled kernels which are better for this workload.
leo: good catch. can we force kernel selector to the older path and re-run? config flag is `USE_CUSTOM_MATMUL=1` at runtime.
marta: tried forcing it: `USE_CUSTOM_MATMUL=1` on ampere -> p95 dropped to within 2% of a100. logs: `kernel_choice=custom_tiled (forced)`.
tae: that points to kernel selector differences as root cause. but we still need apples-to-apples for loadtest parity. Action items: 1) add a matrix test that runs replay + synthetic across image+driver+kernel-flag combinations; 2) lock baseline image for perf comparisons; 3) add a perf regression alert that triggers when replay p95 deviates >5% from historic baseline.
sam: for 1) suggest a simple CI matrix YAML snippet: ```yaml
matrix:
  - image: redwood/runtime:2025-02-10
    cuda: 11.8
    driver: 525.85
  - image: redwood/runtime:2025-02-19
    cuda: 11.8
    driver: 525.85
  - image: redwood/runtime:2025-02-19
    cuda: 12.1
    driver: 535.xx
```
zara: also include small variation in `RUNTIME_KERNEL_FLAGS` and `USE_CUSTOM_MATMUL` to catch selector regressions. and tag benches as `replay` vs `synthetic` for comparison.
marta: added a quick diff of the runtime kernel selector log: ```
[2025-02-19 10:01:12] kernel_selector: selected=cuBLASLt_matmul heuristic_score=0.72
[2025-02-19 10:01:12] kernel_selector: fallback_candidates=[custom_tiled, tiled_sm80]
```
leo: interesting — heuristic_score close to threshold. small change in input shape distribution from replay caused different pick. we should make selector tie-break deterministic and log the input stats that influenced the score.
tae: agreed. for loadtest parity doc, add explicit columns: gpu_type, cuda, driver, container_image, kernel_flags, kernel_selector_version, replay_dataset_hash. that will make triage faster.
sam: for immediate mitigation, pin `kernel_selector_version=v1.17` for the nightly perf master used in benchmarks. also add an automated smoke that runs `tools/run_bench.py --mode mini-replay` after any runtime image build.
marta: I ran the mini-replay after pinning selector and results look aligned. scheduling full matrix now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled job redwood/perf/matrix-1779991234 (queued) :rocket:
leo: leaving a note in the perf playbook about image drift and kernel selector sensitivity.
zara: I'll follow up to ensure the console dashboard shows both replay and synthetic baselines side-by-side. :eyes:
